history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person is descending an escalator in a brightly lit shopping mall. They are wearing a light pink crewneck sweatshirt with white lettering that reads "Just la Bella" in a stylized font. The sweatshirt also has a white trim detail at the bottom. They are also wearing black pants with white graphic details, and a white mesh trucker hat with a blue emblem on the front. The escalator steps are dark gray with yellow safety lines. In the background, a clothing store is visible with mannequins displaying casual wear. The lighting is overhead, creating a clean, well-lit environment typical of a retail space. The overall mood is casual and modern. The color palette is dominated by soft pink, black, white, and the neutral tones of the mall's interior.
